cohort: The participants were mice assigned to control, LPS, and LPS+Lentinan intervention groups to model LPS-induced preterm birth.
finding: Lentinan significantly reduced the rate of LPS-induced preterm birth in mice, improved offspring survival and birth weight, likely by inhibiting the activation of the NF-kB inflammatory pathway.
gest_age: The study aimed to prevent preterm birth, an outcome defined by gestational age, but no specific gestational age range for inclusion was mentioned.
